title: feat(fleet-write): advisory_severity sets an unpublished advisory's severity
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"huangyiirene"} -->
_Requested by **Irene** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67x?thread=cmsg_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67x8Be2AAcUBhodBsvnWLd3Xs)_

Fixes #36805

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户无感（内部工具）：安全席位现在可以经中继直接改未发布安全公告的严重级别，不用再请你在网页上逐份手改。
- 属于安全公告发布流程，替安全席解决「中继改不了级别」：级别决定发布清单的排序，也是公告发布后对外显示的级别。
- 出错时这一步被拒或回读失败、什么都不改；已发布、已撤回、或已填了评分向量的公告一律不碰；本次改动可以直接撤回。
- 无。

## What changes

A new relay row, `advisory_severity` (`scripts/pm/fleet-write`), sets the `severity` of a repository security advisory that is not published.

- **Op table (`ops.mjs`).** Required `ghsa_id` and `severity`, nothing optional. `severity` is the existing field the report and the draft already take: the quiet closed enum `ADVISORY_SEVERITIES` (`critical`, `high`, `medium`, `low`). There is still one copy of the enum. The PATCH body is the table's own, exactly `{ severity }`. The row is `alone: true` and spends `repository-advisories: write`, minted for its stroke only, like the other advisory writes. The workflow is unchanged: the grant is derived from the row's `permission`.
- **Validator (`validate.mjs`).** It refuses before any request, naming the key and echoing no value: a missing `ghsa_id`, a malformed `ghsa_id`, a missing `severity`, a value outside the four, and any other key (`cvss_vector_string`, `state`, `summary`, …).
- **Executor (`execute.mjs`).** It reads the advisory first and judges `ADVISORY_SEVERITY_FENCES`. These are `ADVISORY_FENCES` with `from` set to `ADVISORY_SEVERITY_STATES` (`triage`, `draft`, `closed`, the same three as `advisory_note` and `advisory_rewrite`; `published` and `withdrawn` are refused), plus a new `cvss` fence (see below). If a fence fails, the PATCH is not sent (exit 5). The action lands only when the PATCH answer names the advisory, is still in one of the three states, and stores the severity that was sent (`advisorySeverityReadBack`). Otherwise the action FAILS and is never re-sent.
- **Nothing printed.** The landed row is `GHSA-… · state draft · severity set: the answer stores the one sent`. Neither the row nor any refusal or read-back sentence carries the severity word. `advisory_list` already seals every unpublished advisory's severity, so the run log does not print it either. The seat confirms the value afterwards through `advisory_list`'s sealed `severity` field.
- **Docs.** The `ops.mjs` header gets the rows-table line, the executor-path bullet, the grant counts (eight write rows, ten spending the grant), and a new section, "The one row that sets an advisory's severity". That section carries the one-line pointer the card allows: the security lane's write list does not name the row yet, and adding it there is a governed skills edit of its own. The matching header lines in `validate.mjs` and `execute.mjs` are updated too.

**The CVSS vector, measured against GitHub's REST description, not a live advisory.** Source: `github/rest-api-description`, `descriptions/api.github.com/api.github.com.json` at `c9c95fe3`, read 2026-11-24, operation `security-advisories/update-repository-advisory`.
- On `severity` it says: "You must choose between setting this field or `cvss_vector_string`."
- On `cvss_vector_string` it says: "The CVSS vector that calculates the severity of the advisory."
- It documents a 422 with the message "Cannot update severity value when CVSS is set." (example `update_severity_with_cvss_set`).
- So the row takes no vector input. The `cvss` fence refuses, with nothing sent, any advisory that carries a vector in `cvss` or in `cvss_severities` (`cvss_v3` or `cvss_v4`). It also refuses, failing closed, an advisory that answers either field in a shape it cannot judge.
- Setting the severity of such an advisory stays the maintainer's job in the GitHub UI. The seat's routing call (2026-11-25, option A): the row stays as built, inside the card. An advisory that carries a CVSS vector is refused at the `cvss` fence, and the maintainer's UI handles that subset. Clearing or writing a vector through the relay is not part of this PR.

**Landing.** As expected: `ops.mjs`, `validate.mjs` and `execute.mjs`. `dispatch.mjs` needs no change: the seat's packer derives the row from the table, and the seat reads the value back through the existing `advisory_list`.

## Why

The maintainer handed severity grading to the security seat (「级别也你修改」, then 「先立卡处理，支持车队改级别」). No relay row could set the field: `ADVISORY_REWRITE_FIELDS` covers only `summary` and `description`, and `advisory_report`'s `severity` applies only to a new report. A seat's direct PATCH is correctly refused by the session proxy. Until now, every graded advisory waited on a manual edit by the maintainer. The field orders the publish list and is what a published advisory shows.

## Tests

Self-tests on head `03e197db`:

- `node scripts/pm/fleet-write/validate.mjs --self-test` ⇒ `✓ fleet-write/validate self-test: 480 cases pass across 24 batteries` (463 / 23 on main). The new battery `advisory_severity: …` has floor 17, and the battery floor rises from 23 to 24.
- `node scripts/pm/fleet-write/execute.mjs --self-test` ⇒ `✓ fleet-write/execute self-test: 471 cases pass across 32 batteries` (464 / 31 on main). The new battery has floor 7, and the battery floor rises from 31 to 32.
- `node scripts/pm/fleet-write/dispatch.mjs --self-test` ⇒ `✓ … 430 cases pass across 34 batteries` (unchanged).

New pins:
- **Op table, closed shape.** The row's keys, permission, alone flag and gate. `FIELDS.severity.values === ADVISORY_SEVERITIES` (one copy). The three rows that take `severity`. ONE PATCH whose body is exactly `{ severity }`, for each of the four values.
- **Validator, one refusal per bad input.** Missing `ghsa_id`; malformed `ghsa_id` (ten spellings); missing `severity`; twelve values outside the enum, all refused by the key's name with no echo; fifteen extra keys, each refused by name. Also: alone beside a comment, beside another advisory row, and two severities in one stroke. The grant mints `repository-advisories` write only, with `advisory_note=` empty.
- **Fences (pure and executor).** Triage, draft and closed pass. Published, withdrawn, a missing state and an unknown state are refused at `state`. A vector at `cvss`, at `cvss_v3` or at `cvss_v4`, a blank vector, and five shapes the platform does not declare are refused at `cvss`. Each executor case is "not sent", zero writes, exit 5.
- **Read-back.** It lands in each of the three states. It FAILS on another severity, on no severity, on a value of no declared shape, on a published answer, on another advisory, on a refusal, and on a non-advisory answer. Each failure is one write and is never re-sent. The platform's "CVSS is set" 422 is printed as its cause, with the remedy.
- **Marker sweep.** 22 executor runs. The marker and the vector appear on no log line, row, summary, annotation or pace-log line. The severity word appears on no row, summary or annotation.

Existing pins that enumerate the advisory rows were extended: the three minimal-shape ledgers, the alone list, the `repository-advisories` spenders (now ten), the rows-table pin and the security-advisories request list (now six PATCHes).

<details><summary>Ablations (one leg per new behaviour; mutated with scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, each restored to the HEAD blob 3cdd1a20)</summary>

| mutation in `ops.mjs` | validate | execute |
|:---|:---|:---|
| read-back skips the severity compare | 1 of 480 failed | 1 of 471 failed |
| `ADVISORY_SEVERITY_STATES` admits `published` | 4 of 480 failed | 2 of 471 failed |
| `cvss` fence always passes | 2 of 480 failed | 1 of 471 failed |

Each restore printed `ok restored: blob == HEAD (3cdd1a20f134) and git diff HEAD is empty`.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Severity word not printed (Zone 2 H3: the hypothesis to print it is falsified by precedent).** `advisory_list` seals `severity`, and its self-test pins that no listing sentence names a severity. This row follows that pin: it reports only that the answer stores the severity sent.
- **States (H1).** The row copies `advisory_note` and `advisory_rewrite`: `triage`, `draft` and `closed`. `advisory_versions` writes in `draft` only because its list is replaced wholesale before a publish. A severity has no such ordering, and a closed advisory is exactly what sits in the publish list.
- **One enum (H2: confirmed).** The row reuses `ADVISORY_SEVERITIES`. `ADVISORY_LIST_SEVERITIES` (the list page's read-side check) is a second copy that was already on `main`. It is left alone here and noted in the report.
- **CVSS (H4: confirmed as a documented refusal).** See What changes. No vector input was added. The seat chose option A (2026-11-25): a CVSS-carrying advisory is refused at the fence and stays on the maintainer's UI route.
- **Live confirmation.** The relay executes `main`'s scripts, so the App's PATCH of `severity` in each of the three states is confirmed by the first live run after merge.
- `dispatch.mjs`'s usage text does not list the row: the packer derives it from the table, and the file is outside this card's expected landing.
- **Contract review.** This diff touches no contract face of `references/contract-review.md` and no governed surface (only `scripts/pm/fleet-write/**`).

## Verification

**Read first (by risk):**
1. `scripts/pm/fleet-write/ops.mjs`: `ADVISORY_SEVERITY_FENCES` and `advisoryCvssVectorOf`, which decide what is never sent.
2. `scripts/pm/fleet-write/ops.mjs`: `advisorySeverityReadBack`, which decides what counts as landed and what the log may say.
3. `scripts/pm/fleet-write/execute.mjs`: `advisoryPreflight` (the severity branch) and the `advisorySeverity` arm of `confirmAdvisory`.

**Two-minute check:** run `node scripts/pm/fleet-write/validate.mjs --self-test && node scripts/pm/fleet-write/execute.mjs --self-test`. Expect `480 cases pass across 24 batteries`, then `471 cases pass across 32 batteries`.

<details><summary>Local gates on 03e197db</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 63 families for the 3 changed paths.
- `--ran` reconciliation: `✓ dispatch-gates --ran: 63 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 62 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED (1 DERIVED from a recorded exit 3)`.
- All 62 run families exited 0. They include `check:pm-fleet-write-validate`, `-execute`, `-dispatch`, `check:pm-dispatch-gates` (fast tier, 2273 cases), `check:pm-governed-merges`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:commit-card-trailers` and `check:issue-citations`.
- NOT MEASURED: `check:i18n-coverage` (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: the workspace CLI is not built). This diff builds no package, so that family is left to CI.
- `node scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs`: `VERDICT clean exit 0` (0 PR heads share these files).
- `node scripts/check-commit-card-trailers.mjs --range origin/main..HEAD`: clean.
</details>

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (No `packages/spec` change.)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [ ] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (No formatter ran; lint is CI's `Lint & Repo Gates`.)
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset. (`scripts/pm/**` publishes nothing: `skip-changeset`.)
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (Not touched.)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
